description_en: Detaches vServer groups from a scaling group. Auto Scaling supports the attachment of load balancers to scaling groups to improve service performance. If the load balancer currently attached to your scaling group is no longer needed to distribute the access traffic to the instances in your scaling group, you can call the DetachVServerGroups operation to detach one or more vServer groups of this load balancer from the scaling group
description_zh: 伸缩组支持关联负载均衡实例，可以有效增强伸缩组的服务能力。如果您的业务暂不需要通过负载均衡实例将访问流量分发到伸缩组内的多个实例中去，您可以调用API DetachVServerGroups移除一个或者多个虚拟服务器组
kebab_example: aliyun ess detach-vserver-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --scaling-group-id asg-bp1fo0dbtsbmqa9h0000 --vserver-groups '[{"LoadBalancerId":"lb-bp1p90y3ya9h8s62d0000","VServerGroupAttributes":[{}]}]' --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachVServerGroups

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group. Examples: cn-hangzhou and cn-shanghai
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩组所属地域的ID，例如cn-hangzhou、cn-shanghai
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove the existing instances in the scaling group from the vServer group marked for detachment.

true: If you set this parameter to `true`, the detachment of the load balancer from the scaling group causes automatic removal of the existing instances in the scaling group from the corresponding vServer group.
false: If you set this parameter to `false`, the detachment of the load balancer from the scaling group does not cause automatic removal of the existing instances in the scaling group from the corresponding vServer group.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否从待移除虚拟服务器组中移除当前伸缩组内的实例。 

true：移除。如果该参数取值为`true`，则从伸缩组中移除负载均衡实例时，系统会将负载均衡实例后端服务器上与伸缩组关联的实例移除。

false：不移除。如果该参数取值为`false`，则从伸缩组中移除负载均衡实例时，系统不会从负载均衡实例后端服务器上移除与伸缩组关联的实例。

默认值：false
parameters.name: force_detach

fields.help_en:
The ID of the load balancer to which the vServer group belongs.

You can detach vServer groups of up to five load balancers from a scaling group in one call
fields.help_zh:
虚拟服务器组所属负载均衡实例的ID。
支持最多一次从伸缩组移除5个负载均衡实例
fields.name: load_balancer_id

fields.help_en: The port number that Auto Scaling employs to incorporate instances into the vServer group. Valid values: 1 to 65535
fields.help_zh: 弹性伸缩将ECS实例或ECI实例添加到虚拟服务器组时使用的端口号，取值范围：1~65535
fields.name: port

fields.help_en: The ID of the backend vServer group
fields.name: vserver_group_id

fields.help_en: The attributes of the backend vServer group
fields.name: vserver_group_attributes

parameters.help_en: The collection of information about the vServer groups marked for detachment
parameters.help_zh: 待移出的虚拟服务器组的信息集合
parameters.name: vserver_groups
